title: RLTP Access Operation Envelope (transcription of Access Layer draft 0.3 section 3.3)
description: TRANSCRIPTION, not the definition: the Access layer owns this shape; this schema exists so Membership Tasks validates its payload offline (Delivery Contract offline schema rule). Self-addressing id (oid: + base64url SHA-256 over the JCS serialization with id empty and proof omitted); every signature covers exactly that serialization. Root is CLOSED; as transcribed from Access 0.3, crit can only NAME extension fields — the closed root admits none, so extensions are impossible in this transcription until the Access layer defines its extension container.

didKey.description: did:key over an Ed25519 public key; MUST additionally decode to multicodec ed25519-pub + 32 bytes (Encounter 2.3)

oid.description: self-addressing operation id: base64url(SHA-256) without padding over the JCS serialization with id empty and proof omitted
